description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid. To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second , integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB , and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes , with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code. Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems. Modern Infrastructure Stack: You are comfortable working with REST APIs, version control via Git, and CI/CD pipelines. You will use these core tools, along with your familiarity in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, to reliably deploy your code into our environments. Iterative Code Ownership: You will work alongside experienced engineers who will rigorously review your pull requests. We need someone who parses technical feedback directly and uses it to continuously refine their system design and coding standards. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly. Key Responsibilities Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces. Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development. Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation. Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance. Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware. Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation. Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities. Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior. Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment. What we would love to see from you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems. Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures. Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent. Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models. Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response. Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous. Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry. Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial. Skills and Behaviours Methodical and structured approach to problem solving. Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor. Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale. Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve. Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development. description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We are seeking a Spacecraft Thermal Engineer to join our Thermal Control System team. You will contribute to the preparation, execution and analysis of thermal verification activities, including Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) and Thermal Balance testing, and support spacecraft assembly, integration and test. Alongside these activities, you will take technical ownership of assigned thermal control products, following their development, supplier activities, qualification and delivery for integration. You will work closely with AIT, suppliers, external test facilities and other subsystem teams. You will be part of the TCS & ECLSS Team and report to the Principal Thermal Control System Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Product Ownership and Supplier Follow-up Take technical ownership of assigned thermal control products, from requirements and interface definition through qualification and delivery for integration, with guidance from senior engineers. Act as the day-to-day technical interface with suppliers, following design, manufacturing, testing and delivery activities. Review supplier deliverables, including design justifications, test procedures and reports, against agreed requirements. Maintain product requirements, interfaces, configuration information and technical documentation. Prepare product review documentation and coordinate the closure of review actions. Track product maturity, technical risks and delivery milestones, escalating issues affecting performance, cost or schedule. Coordinate with AIT to ensure hardware is delivered with the appropriate configuration, documentation and verification status. Thermal Testing and Verification Contribute to the definition of thermal test objectives, configurations and success criteria. Prepare test plans, procedures and instrumentation requirements in coordination with AIT and test facilities. Support spacecraft-level TVAC and Thermal Balance campaigns, and coordinate testing activities for assigned thermal control products. Contribute to test readiness reviews, test execution and anomaly investigations. Prepare test reports and verification evidence, maintaining traceability to applicable requirements. Track verification activities and follow technical actions through to closure within your assigned scope. Flight Model Integration and AIT Support Work alongside AIT teams during the installation, integration and verification of thermal control hardware. Contribute to integration procedures, thermal instrumentation layouts and test configurations. Support functional testing, troubleshooting and spacecraft system check-outs. Support leak testing and fluid loop commissioning, as applicable to assigned activities. Investigate integration issues with the relevant engineering, supplier and quality teams. Thermal Test Data Analysis Support pre-test thermal predictions in collaboration with thermal analysts. Process and analyse test data to assess hardware and system performance against requirements. Contribute to thermal model correlation and the investigation of discrepancies between predictions and test results. Recommend design or test improvements and capture lessons learned. What We Would Love to See from You Qualifications: Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermodynamics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years of relevant experience in spacecraft thermal engineering, including thermal hardware development, integration or testing. Hands-on experience contributing to thermal test campaigns, such as TVAC or Thermal Balance testing. Good understanding of spacecraft thermal control hardware, such as MLI, temperature sensors, heaters and fluid loop components. Familiarity with spacecraft qualification and acceptance processes, requirements traceability and verification documentation. Experience contributing to hardware development or supplier follow-up, including reviewing technical documentation and tracking actions. Familiarity with thermal instrumentation, data acquisition systems and test facility interfaces. Experience processing and analysing engineering data using Python, MATLAB or equivalent tools. Familiarity with applicable space engineering standards, including ECSS and NASA ones. Fluent in English. German, French and Italian are an asset. Skills and Behaviors: Ownership mindset, with the ability to drive assigned activities to completion and seek support when needed. Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills. Clear written and verbal communication. Ability to organise priorities, maintain technical documentation and follow actions through to closure. Collaborative approach to working across engineering disciplines, suppliers and AIT teams. Positive and flexible attitude to getting the job done. description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam. Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows. What you'll do As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets Who you are Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions! You could be our next team mate if you: Have 4+ years of Product Management experience, including at least 1 year working on mobile applications, with a track record of shipping products that have delivered meaningful business results and proven user value Have experience developing SaaS or mobile products, ideally including a network effect component such as social networking, communication services, or collaborative workplace tools Approach problems with an analytical mindset, balancing quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions Communicate with clarity and conviction to align diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, driving vision and articulating user value and business impact Are highly organised and disciplined in project management, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to ask tough questions and say no when needed Now, it would be fantastic if you: Have experience with health tech, marketplace, or platform products Are familiar with operating in multi-market environments Have worked in a scale-up or fast-paced product organisation Our AI vision We believe in the responsible use of AI to improve healthcare.
